seo.title: Artificial intelligence for public institutions | Humanika
seo.description: AI agents for public institutions: citizen services, requests, procedures, procurement and MGA projects, with approved sources and human review.

hero.title: Artificial intelligence serving citizens and your teams
hero.description: Humanika helps city halls, regional governments and state agencies serve people better, process procedures with less rework and decide with information. Each agent uses the institution's approved information and leaves decisions to its staff.

families.title: Agents for every area of public management
families.description: Six solution families you can implement separately or combine based on your institution's priorities.

items.title: Citizen services
items.text: Guidance over chat, WhatsApp, voice and kiosks, citizen request management and service quality control.

items.title: Documents and procedures
items.text: Manual and regulation lookups, document reading, case file pre-validation and task automation.

items.title: Public procurement and investment
items.text: Tender review, contract tracking and investment project formulation with the MGA methodology.

items.title: Research and participation
items.text: Interviews, surveys and public consultation analysis, linked to each original contribution.

items.title: Staff training
items.text: Onboarding paths, simulated practice scenarios and language learning with AI tutors.

items.title: Computer vision
items.text: Foot traffic measurement on site and inspections documented from photos.

principles.title: Trustworthy AI for the public sector
principles.description: Four principles we apply in every implementation.

items.title: Approved information only
items.text: Agents answer with the sources the institution approves: manuals, regulations, procedures and procedure data.

items.title: Staff make the decisions
items.text: Agents prepare, summarize and suggest. People review, approve and handle the cases that need them.

items.title: Traceability at every step
items.text: Every conversation, operation and document is logged to audit what was done, when and with what information.

items.title: Channels citizens already use
items.text: WhatsApp, web chat, phone lines and on-site kiosks, with handoff to an operator when needed.

cta.title: See how it would work at your institution
cta.description: Tell us which procedure or service you want to improve and we'll show you an agent configured with a real case from your institution.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hi, I work at a public institution and I'd like to request a Humanika demo.
